fidelity: F2a — Physics-Lumped 1D Channel Flow with Saha Conductivity + Hall Effect
source: Rosa, R.J. (1987) Magnetohydrodynamic Energy Conversion, McGraw-Hill; Sutton, G.W. & Sherman, A. (1965) Engineering Magnetohydrodynamics, McGraw-Hill; Messerle, H.K. (1995) MHD Electrical Power Generation, Wiley

unit.name: Open-cycle Faraday MHD generator (K2CO3/Cs-seeded combustion plasma, superconducting magnet)

K_load.note: Load factor K = E/(u*B); K=0.5 is the maximum-power point

channel_length.note: Faraday channel length along flow direction x

channel_width.note: Channel width (electrode spacing d, perpendicular to B and u)

channel_height.note: Channel height in B direction at inlet

area_ratio.note: Outlet/inlet cross-sectional area ratio (diverging channel to limit Mach rise)

u_inlet.note: Plasma inlet velocity (supersonic combustion flow ~700-1000 m/s)

T_inlet.note: Plasma inlet static temperature (seeded combustion ~2500-3000 K)

p_inlet.note: Plasma inlet static pressure (~5 atm combustor)

mdot.note: Plasma mass flow rate through channel

cp_plasma.note: Specific heat at constant pressure of seeded combustion gas

gamma_plasma.note: Ratio of specific heats for hot combustion gas

M_gas.note: Mean molar mass of combustion gas (~air-like)

seed_fraction.note: Mole fraction of alkali seed (K) in the gas

E_ion_seed.note: First ionization energy of potassium seed (Cs=3.89, K=4.34, Na=5.14)

sigma_floor.note: Lower clamp on conductivity for numerical stability

sigma_scale.note: Calibration factor for electron-neutral collisions: sigma=scale*n_e*e*mu_e maps idealized Saha n_e to measured ~10-40 S/m (Sutton & Sherman 1965)

mu_e.note: Electron mobility in seeded combustion plasma (sets Hall parameter beta=mu_e*B~2 at 5T)
